name_reason: Follows data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (domain=chapter_intro); _ptr suffix correctly reflects the 4-byte pointer data type; 'active_metadata_entry' accurately names what it caches (the currently-active chapter's intro metadata entry pointer returned by fd2_get_chapter_intro_metadata_entry). No Ghidra address residue (no hex suffix matching 0x54137 or any address). No domain ID to preserve.
purpose: Cached pointer to the active chapter's intro metadata entry (the byte array returned by fd2_get_chapter_intro_metadata_entry).
logic_summary: BSS pointer slot, NULL at program start. Assigned at runtime by two writers: fd2_chapter_transition_menu @0x2cd24 (story-chapter intro opens, caches metadata=fd2_get_chapter_intro_metadata_entry(current_chapter)) and fd2_load_state_from_selected_slot @0x303c4 (save-slot restore refreshes it for the restored chapter). Two readers dereference it byte-wise at fixed offsets: fd2_chapter_transition_menu @0x2cede reads [+2]=special-hotkey scancode and [+1]=special-hotkey cursor index to jump the intro radio menu to option 5; fd2_load_chapter_party_roster @0x2d3e4 reads per-state party-roster byte slices at [+3..] (state 1, cap 0xC), [+0x0F..] (state 3, cap 8), or [+0x17..] (else, cap 8), copying until a 0xFF terminator. Held as undefined4 to match the dword pointer load/store at the use sites; the entry is then read via *(uint8 *)(ptr+N).
datatype: undefined4 (4-byte pointer slot; .object2 BSS, NULL at start)
element_semantics: Single 32-bit slot holding a pointer to a chapter-intro metadata byte array. The pointed-to entry is read byte-wise: [+1]=special-hotkey cursor index, [+2]=special-hotkey scancode, [+3..]/[+0x0F..]/[+0x17..]=per-transition-state party-roster char-id slices (0xFF-terminated).
notes: All 4 xrefs verified by decompiling both readers (fd2_chapter_transition_menu @0x2cede, fd2_load_chapter_party_roster @0x2d3e4) and both writers (fd2_chapter_transition_menu @0x2cd24, fd2_load_state_from_selected_slot @0x303c4). Existing source comment block (chtrans.c lines 637-652) is accurate and precise on every point: cached metadata pointer, NULL at start, both write sites, byte-wise deref offsets [+1]/[+2]/[+3..]/[+0x0F..]/[+0x17..], 32-bit slot rationale. is_const=false: two game-side write-xrefs (0x2cd24, 0x303c4). Ghidra confirms SYMBOL_NAME matches live name, MEMBLOCK=.object2, DATA_TYPE=undefined4 len 4, no existing PLATE/EOL comment. Plate left as none (absent, not contradictory; source is the documentation source of truth).
